Question: Let \(1,\) \(4,\) \(\ldots\) and \(9,\) \(16,\) \(\ldots\) be two arithmetic progressions. The set \(S\) is the union of the first \(2004\) terms of each sequence. How many distinct numbers are in \(S?\)
